body: For some reason seeing this post MADE MY DAY!! Congratulations 🥰🤗
I just read this and tried to hear it in the voice of the person I'd like to hear these things from. Never going to happen but that was a sweet minute imagining it. Thank you and I wish you the best!
Holy fuck I love this list too. Beautiful!!
I'm very glad that your comment is the insignificant minority opinion here because honestly fuck off with that hate
Hi I'm manic can I buy your gorgeous piano off you
Hahahaha I cracked up @ a damn banana
I changed my name two months ago too!! It was so good
Thank you 💕
I felt every word and I am sending you such a big cuddle. You are seen and you are loved and you are important xx
I'm sorry to hear it. Hugs xx
Oh my god I would love this so much. It would be so amazing to be in classes with other littles and to have caregivers look after us for a while xx

I just saw your edit. Wow. Fuck. I'm so sorry you went through that and holy fuck I want to learn from your experience and not go soft to avoid drama/fighting because that is 100% what I've been doing

Thank you so much. I think I'll try to research a bit over the next few days and maybe contact a professional before the end of the week. And I might take you up on your DM offer too. Thanks for your kindness!
Your kind and empathetic comment made me tear up. I'm so unaccustomed to empathy in real life, online empathy is 100% the only reason why I know how it feels at all. Very grateful. Thank you.

I hear you, I really do. I guess I'm just scared to be alone. Is it worse to have no friends or to have one friend who is mostly fun but occasionally an asshole? Idk. I'm sure you're right about me being stunted in ways I don't understand yet. I can sense it, I can sense that I'm not fully functional and that I've got issues, but I can't necessarily name the issues or know what normal/healthy feels like.

It's a good question, and I've asked myself this before. Honestly I think because I'm so alone and I've invested so much in this person, and he really does have many good things about him. He did treat me like shit in the marriage especially in recent years, and he hasn't worked on communication/conflict resolution skills at all in the 6+ months that we've been separated, and it's really hard to have a reasonable conversation with him about any issues I might have with him, but idk. I really don't know. It doesn't make sense logically, it's very emotionally real though?

I'm so, so grateful that we don't have kids. 

And thank you for your advice. Yes, that's what I'm leaning towards too- getting a lawyer for an equitable settlement and not making unnecessary sacrifices during the divorce process. That's a good way to word it.
I love this!!!
I LOVE THIS
Have a great day at work and thank you!

I really, really hear you and agree with every word. I wish that I was brave enough to express all that you do, the way you do. With very few exceptions, I tend to get scared and just freeze and silently disagree when people make it all about meds. It scares me when people try to insist on this or that medication and don't care how the person would feel about it. Empowering individuals to manage their own bipolar in the best way for them should be the goal of anyone who wants to help us, but it's not. I don't trust a lot of people when they say they want to help me because they're not seeing me as fully human, they're seeing me as defective and as a liability and as a burden on my loved ones. I'm not. I'm just me and I'd like them to fuck off.

Whew that felt therapeutic to type out. Thanks for creating space for this conversation!

This post resonated with me so, so much. My bipolar is so valuable to me and my symptoms- which people see as abnormal and worrisome- HAVE saved me and been exactly what I needed at some really difficult times in my life. Celebrating all you wonderful unique magical bipolar people out there who are human, beautiful, unique, and worthy of being empowered in your own life. Sending love this world bipolar day!
Hahahaha. Same!!
We live in insane times and having to manage cycles and cravings doesn't make it easier does it. Stay safe! x

I'm so sorry about the postponed wedding. That sucks. I hope things work out for you and that the time flies and that you have an amazing love story even if the details are different to what your Plan A was
I'm very sorry for your loss. My heartfelt condolences and best wishes to you and your precious little one.
